signal_attribution.reasoning_chain: Negative GEX (-$312M) plus VX backwardation (-2.6%) puts the market in an EXPLOSIVE regime, where backtested bullish accuracy is 65.5% → CAG shows extreme fear (z=+2.22, gap 1.07 BULL-DELUDED), which is a contrarian bullish edge → SPX spot 7182.78 sits above the 7150 put wall, with the 7250 call wall as the upside boundary → mega-cap deep ITM call flow (AMZN $13.41M, META $10.37M) offsets the P/C 1.271 hedging tilt → low regime confidence (22%), weak intraday accuracy (48.9%) and a closed market keep confidence at 32/48/60 with ranges widened but point targets modest.
